nodes.label: Dengue bundle - OpenDengue best-spatial extract
nodes.rationale: 12 countries, 7,165 nodes, 1,409 weekly steps, mask density 0.2175. A national aggregate is never a node, because a country with a single national series is a graph singleton carrying no spatial-coupling signal - the very quantity the model exists to exploit; 57 otherwise-endemic countries are excluded on that basis. Level is resolved per country at the finest level clearing the coverage thresholds, since the coarsest-adequate rule would have selected Colombia's sparse 2001-2003 Admin-1 fragment over its much richer Admin-2 series.

nodes.label: The Admin-2 key collision defect
nodes.rationale: Admin-2 unit names are not unique within a country - Brazil has 239 municipality names shared by two to five states - so a leaf-only key summed geographically distinct municipalities into one node (64,104 Brazilian cells, 413 collisions total) and also corrupted the coverage gate by pooling their observed weeks. Adding the parent province to the key took nodes 7,030 -> 7,443 (an increase of exactly the collision count) and duplicate (node, week) cells 74,952 -> 0, which retracts the earlier finding that those rows were legitimate sub-weekly reports: the original diagnostic could not distinguish the two cases because it counted duplicates under the broken key.

nodes.label: Per-country chronological 50/20/30 split
nodes.rationale: A single global positional cut on the union calendar would starve Brazil, Japan, Ecuador, Panama and Argentina of training cells entirely - silently, since no schema check would fail. Every node of a country takes that country's boundary without exception, which keeps the block-diagonal graph temporally consistent: a GNN aggregates over neighbours, so a training cell beside a test cell in the same week would pull the test period into the training forward pass. The earlier per-node fallback that guaranteed each node a training cell is removed; the 475 affected nodes now take their country's pooled training statistics.

nodes.label: Zero-variance node guard and its mis-fire
nodes.rationale: The guard fires on 400 of 7,165 nodes, not the 30 earlier reported - the earlier figure counted only nodes constant across their entire history, while the guard fires on any node with no variance inside its training window. 76 of the 400 had real held-out variance and the blanket sd=1 guard left them un-normalised on the raw log1p scale while every neighbour was standardised. The country-pooled fallback now applies, computed from training cells only so no leakage is introduced, and the blanket guard now fires on zero nodes.

nodes.label: Country-macro headline metric (score.py)
nodes.rationale: Scored per node over observed test cells, averaged within each country, then across the twelve countries with equal weight, with the equal-node average alongside as the secondary figure. It neutralises Brazil's 77 per cent node share without discarding data, which is what makes keeping all nodes sound. Self-tested: a Bolivia-only error of 10 moves the equal-node mean 0.015 and the country-macro 0.833, about 10/12.

nodes.label: Constant nodes excluded from scoring, retained in the graph
nodes.rationale: 29 of Japan's 47 prefectures report zero dengue in every observed week - true zeros, since dengue is not endemic there. A constant prediction is trivially exact on such a node and its correlation is undefined, so under a country-macro headline Japan's twelfth of the score would substantially measure the prediction of a constant. 559 nodes are constant over their test window and excluded; 6,161 are scored; Japan is also reported with them removed as a sensitivity. They stay in the graph as valid message-passing neighbours.

nodes.label: Brazilian dominance and the sampler decision
nodes.rationale: Brazil supplies 77.0 per cent of dengue nodes. Reporting is de-biased by the country-macro metric rather than by discarding nodes. Uniform node sampling stays primary - the encoder is data-proportional and therefore Brazil-weighted, which preserves the full training signal - and a country-balanced sampler is built as an ablation, decided empirically rather than by decree.

nodes.label: Dengue block-diagonal graph - a known mis-specification
nodes.rationale: 7,165 nodes, 20,468 undirected edges, mean degree 5.71, zero cross-border edges. The construction was justified on the premise that the dengue countries are not adjacent, and that premise is marked False: Brazil borders Colombia, Peru, Bolivia and Argentina, so the block-diagonal build severs real transmission corridors including Leticia-Tabatinga and the Triple Frontier. Defensible only as a deliberate simplification, and recorded as such rather than as a geographic fact. Contiguity is also an induced subgraph, so degree is a property of coverage as well as of geography.

nodes.label: Dengue name join and the two alias maps
nodes.rationale: 302 nodes failed the initial join; five Colombian department names alone orphaned 100 municipalities. Every alias is resolved by exact match against a real shapefile key, never fuzzily - approximate matching would have bound antioquia|san andres to andes, a different municipality. Folding GADM's own misspellings into the load-time map shipped nodes named japan|naoasaki and peru|huanuco|huenuco, propagating the shapefile's typos into identifiers that would have been printed in the paper's node table; a join-time map now absorbs them and never renames a node. Unmatched nodes halt construction.

nodes.label: Declared alterations to the dengue data
nodes.rationale: Taiwan's 287 townships aggregated into 22 counties because GADM ships no township layer and no alias can supply a missing layer; seven post-vintage units folded into pre-split parents whose polygons still contain their territory; two concurrent Nicaraguan health districts summed - the one merger resting on an administrative reading rather than arithmetic, and flagged as such; four split series reunited (disjoint eras make the merge unambiguous, and DR then lands on exactly 32 nodes, corroborating it); one mislabelled Argentine node dropped with its reason declared. Brazil required no alterations at all.

nodes.label: Dengue case definitions over time - measured, not asserted
nodes.rationale: An adversarial review reported multipliers up to x220, computed by grouping the raw source file by case_definition_standardised - not a property of any node's time series. Measured per node on the extracted values the real exposure is Mexico 2.8x and Bolivia 1.6x across 41 of 7,165 nodes; Peru and the Dominican Republic are single-definition throughout. Kept as built and disclosed, since truncating to a single-definition era would remove real data to suppress a distortion smaller than the trend it is entangled with. The recurring lesson: a per-node-over-time question must be measured on the per-node series, not on a raw-file group-by.

nodes.label: Influenza bundles - ColaGNN benchmark matrices used unchanged
nodes.rationale: Purpose is exact comparability: results are meant to sit directly beside published baselines, which requires an identical graph, so Delphi's live API and the WHO global database were both rejected on the same ground. The three benchmarks have disjoint node sets and different calendars and are produced as three independent datasets rather than one stitched matrix - and independence is asserted at build time rather than merely intended, so the instruction not to concatenate is a checked property.

nodes.label: US matrices identified as CDC ILINet at a known vintage
nodes.rationale: What began as calendar reconstruction ended as provenance identification: 759 of 785 regional rows are identical to ILINet across all ten regions simultaneously and the state matrix matches 97.5 per cent of cells, the residue being post-hoc backfill. Row 368 equals epiweek 200942 to the case, fixing the start at 2002-10-05 - a far stronger pin than the earlier post-hoc argument that chose the series maximum and then chose the event explaining it. Both US anchors were 39 weeks out under the obvious January reading, putting the seasonality channels ~180 degrees out of phase, and a row-count test could not catch it because the count matches under either anchor.

nodes.label: Japanese prefecture ordering recovered from three independent lines of evidence
nodes.rationale: The nodes are anonymous indices and a wrong ordering would silently corrupt any covariate join. Graph isomorphism pins 41 of 47 uniquely; population correlation (Spearman +0.949 with mean case counts) separates the automorphic orbits; and seasonal phase identifies Okinawa, which is five standard deviations below the national winter concentration. Kochi/Kagawa is the weakest identification and is recorded as moderate confidence - a transposition changes no model result because the nodes are automorphic, and would matter only for a covariate join.

nodes.label: Japan calendar pinned to the week against NIID season peaks
nodes.rationale: Formerly justified on seasonal phase alone (+/-4 weeks). The 2018/19 maximum lands on 2019-01-26 and the 2017/18 maximum on 2018-02-03, each the exact epidemiological week NIID records, and a one-week shift would move at least one maximum off its dated week. Re-asserted on every run by japan_calendar_pin.py.

nodes.label: Influenza adjacency diagonal zeroed to match the built graphs
nodes.rationale: All three shipped adjacencies carry a self-loop on every node while dengue and Ebola do not, so under the standard renormalisation influenza nodes would get twice the self-weight of dengue nodes - a systematic structural difference from which the encoder could infer which disease it is looking at. Teaching the encoder to omit the identity for influenza alone is disease-specific special-casing, which reintroduces the same problem through another door. The operation is information-preserving: the shipped matrix is exactly recoverable by adding back the identity.

nodes.label: Four isolated influenza nodes (Alaska, Hawaii, Hokkaido, Okinawa)
nodes.rationale: Zeroing the diagonal exposed what the self-loops concealed: four nodes whose only entry was the self-loop. The isolation is inherited from the shipped graph, not introduced. They are deliberately not patched with a nearest-neighbour edge, although the builder does exactly that for dengue and Ebola, because inventing an edge absent from the shipped graph would destroy the exact comparability that is the sole reason for reusing it. They become non-degenerate only through the encoder's uniform addition of the identity - which is why that addition is a hard constraint on the model.

nodes.label: Mobility adjacency declined for every disease
nodes.rationale: A real commuting matrix exists for Japan and is tempting, but no equivalent exists for dengue or Ebola, so attaching it to Japan alone would reintroduce exactly the cross-disease asymmetry that zeroing the adjacency diagonal removes. Its own node ordering is also undocumented.

nodes.label: Influenza covariates validated against independently-known geography
nodes.rationale: A mis-joined geometry fails silently - plausible numbers attached to the wrong nodes, with nothing downstream complaining. Each region's area equals the sum of its member states' areas although the two geometries are built by different routes, and the regional-minus-state total is exactly Florida plus DC, precisely the units the regional series includes and the 49-state series excludes. This is a third independent confirmation of the recovered node orderings.

nodes.label: Ebola bundle - OCHA ROWCA compilation
nodes.rationale: 61 districts over 52 weekly steps (2014-04-05 -> 2015-03-28), mask density 0.4095. A manual compilation of WHO and Ministry of Health situation reports, the only source in the project with no version number, so its checksum is its only version identifier. The recorded hash is that of the file as published: an earlier working copy had been opened and re-saved in a spreadsheet application, which rewrites the container without altering a cell, so a reviewer hashing their own download would have obtained a mismatch. Sierra Leone reports 17 district labels but has 14 districts, hence 64 raw labels against 61 nodes; administrative levels are mixed across countries, as in dengue.

nodes.label: Ebola signal-confirmation audit (ebola_audit.py)
nodes.rationale: Data scarcity was the project's principal risk, so usable signal had to be confirmed before the few-shot design could rest on it. Read-only, escalates on any drift from the recorded figures, and re-asserts every count on each run - so a change in the source file's contents fails loudly rather than quietly shifting the reported numbers. 64 clean district series, mean 27.1 observed weeks, 1,299 observed cells.

nodes.label: The clip defect that fabricated 36 per cent of the Ebola target
nodes.rationale: The conversion ended in max(0, dC) on the reasoning that a downward step is reporting reconciliation. A cumulative count cannot fall: where the report falls, the report is a single-week data-entry dropout. The clip zeroed the fall and then released the recovery - the climb back to cases already counted - as new incidence, fabricating 8,786 cases (+35.8 per cent), putting the six largest cells in the dataset there as artefacts, and displacing the national peak from late 2014 to 2015-02-14. No check caught it because the suite compared the transform against nothing the transform had not itself produced.

nodes.label: Difference the running maximum (mass-preserving transform)
nodes.rationale: The monotone envelope absorbs a dropout: the affected week yields no increment and the recovery yields only the rise above the previous high-water mark, instead of re-releasing mass already counted. Mass-conserving by construction - increments sum to max(C) - C_first exactly. Weeks falling below the running maximum are masked because they are corrupt reports, not observations of zero. On the released build the target totals 24,552 against a reference of 24,552 and the national peak sits at 2014-10-25 (2,688 cases/week).

nodes.label: The week-zero backlog defect
nodes.rationale: Assigning each district's entire cumulative total to date as its week-zero incidence put 4.1 per cent of all incidence in week zero and handed 10 of 64 districts a false all-time maximum. The root cause is identifiability, not tuning: at a district's first report the predecessor cumulative is unknown, so the increment does not exist and assigning the total fabricates it. This is not a late-joining-district problem - the compilation opens months into an outbreak, so every district's first report is a backlog. Masking week zero also closed an unlooked-for leak, since week zero was the first support week for every district and those fabricated backlogs dominated the pooled scaler for the entire held-out disease. Cost: 61 cells.

nodes.label: Gap-lumping - disclosed, not corrected (decision A4)
nodes.rationale: Differencing recovers how many cases accrued between two reports but not when within the interval, so where a district falls silent and then files, the whole multi-week increment is stamped on the week the report arrived - 7 per cent of intervals exceed one week, the longest is 24, and Montserrado carries 1,428 cases on 2014-10-25. No cases are invented and the curve is correctly shaped, but weekly peaks are inflated and their neighbours flattened. Both remedies change the target - one invents an unobserved within-gap distribution, the other discards evaluation data - so the decision is to disclose and proceed, repeating the caveat wherever a weekly Ebola magnitude is quoted.

nodes.label: Calendar-prefix few-shot support protocol
nodes.rationale: Every observed cell on or before a fixed cutoff is support; every later observed cell is query. It replaced a per-district scheme (first two observed weeks of each district) that was not calendar-causal: support cells spanned 2014-04-12 to 2015-02-14 and 1,004 of 1,178 query cells (85 per cent) lay earlier in calendar time than the last support cell, so the pooled scaler normalising an early cell was a function of another district's peak-epidemic magnitudes. That defect was invisible to the suite structurally, because the old check defined the support mask as the legitimate fit set - the assumption under attack. Under the Phase-2 cutoff 2014-05-24: 27 support cells across 9 districts, 1,272 query cells, and 52 of 61 districts pure zero-shot, which is the genuine emerging-outbreak regime rather than a defect.

nodes.label: Two frozen Ebola support-length arms (L12 primary, L20 secondary)
nodes.rationale: The Phase-2 cutoff yields zero adaptation pairs at h10 and h15, so the client (D16) chose to run both arms pre-registered, frozen and hashed before either is scored: cutoff 2014-06-28 (59 support cells, 18 districts, 0 pairs at h15) and 2014-08-23 (113 cells, 36 districts, 54 pairs at h15). The query counts are identical under both arms because a full-window query target sits at column 22 and support reaches at most column 20, so the arms differ only in labelled adaptation data, never in what is evaluated - asserted by freeze_ebola_arms.py rather than assumed. The L labels are 0-based indices of the last support column, off by one against the column counts; the cutoff date is the operative definition.

nodes.label: Scored vs reachable pairs (pre-registration amendment A1)
nodes.rationale: Reachable counts per-horizon origins, so h3 reaches origin 48 and h15 only 36; scored uses one common origin set for every horizon, t in [19,36], which is what bundles.origins() returns and therefore what score_predictions evaluates. Horizons are comparable to each other only if read at the same origins, so the common set is the right protocol - and quoting the reachable figures as the evaluation size overstates h3/h5/h10 by 34 to 52 per cent. Found by reading the scoring path before the run rather than after it.

nodes.label: Ebola graph is deliberately not block-diagonal
nodes.rationale: Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone are physically contiguous and 2014 was a single outbreak spreading across them, so the dengue rationale does not transfer: the Gueckedou-Lofa-Kailahun tri-border area is the defining transmission pathway, and a block-diagonal graph would sever exactly the edges carrying the epidemiological signal. That would be a modelling error, not a convention choice. 61 nodes, 146 edges, 21 cross-border edges, all three tri-border edges asserted on every build.

nodes.label: Four Guinean districts that record no incidence at all
nodes.rationale: They reported for six to forty-one weeks but never recorded a new case: their one to three cases predate their first report and therefore sit in the masked backlog. Correct, not a defect. Retained as real districts and valid neighbours, and unlike Japan's zero-variance dengue nodes their scaler cannot degenerate, because the Ebola scaler is pooled across the disease rather than fitted per node.

nodes.label: Declared alterations to the Ebola data
nodes.rationale: Port merged into Port Loko - one district recorded under two labels, the second beginning the day after the first ends and continuing the same cumulative series, which also dissolves the file's worst week-zero anomaly. Western Area dropped as the parent of its two children, which it overlaps in time and would triple-count; Freetown dropped as a city inside Western Area Urban with no district polygon, its five cases not folded in because it cannot be verified whether the district total already included them. An undeclared multi-district aggregate label raises an error rather than being quietly ingested.

nodes.label: Ebola 'new cases' series adopted as a cross-check
nodes.rationale: It had been declined as sparser and inconsistently capitalised; the capitalisation is handled by the same canonicalisation as every other field and the series carries 95 per cent of the cumulative series' coverage. It is a directly reported incidence series, so it needs no differencing and cannot be corrupted by the clip class of defect - had it been used as a cross-check the defect would have been caught immediately. Changing the target now would invalidate the build, so it is adopted as a cross-check instead, letting the target's credibility rest on two independently reported series.

nodes.label: The leakage and invariant suite (86 -> 101 gates)
nodes.rationale: Gates the build: packaging writes nothing if any gate fails, on the principle that a dataset with a leak, once written, is a dataset somebody will train on. The count of gates is not a measure of their coverage - 83 gates passed a build in which 36 per cent of the Ebola target was fabricated and 31 per cent of dengue's observed cells sat in mixed-phase columns; both defects were found in adversarial review, not by the suite. A green suite is evidence only about the properties it actually tests.

nodes.label: Scaler gates built as probes, after a circularity failure
nodes.rationale: A cell the scaler must not see is corrupted, the scaler refitted, and the gate requires that nothing moves. The first suite recovered raw counts by inverting the normalised series with the very scaler under test - circular, because the reconstruction already carries the leak - and it passed a deliberately leaked Ebola scaler with every gate green. Each dataset therefore now ships its raw, unscaled incidence, which no scaler has touched, and every scaler gate is evaluated against that.

nodes.label: Mass-conservation gate (cumulative_reference_mass)
nodes.rationale: Computes the implied mass directly from the source column, sharing only the weekly resampling with the transform and none of the increment logic, and fails the build if the weekly series sums to more than that reference. Added precisely because the original defect survived 83 gates: no check compared the transform against anything the transform had not itself produced.

nodes.label: Calendar-causality gate for the few-shot split
nodes.rationale: Checks that every support cell is dated on or before every query cell, computed from the cells' dates rather than from the mask that defines them - the property the earlier suite structurally could not test. It cannot be probed by perturbing week zero: the series is cumulative, so altering the initial value also alters the week-one increment and the test would fail for the wrong reason; the perturbation must be applied to a query week.

nodes.label: Phase-purity gate on split columns
nodes.rationale: No (country, week) column may hold cells from more than one split phase, so a training cell never sits beside a test cell in a neighbourhood a graph network aggregates over. The note previously asserted this invariant while the code violated it on 792 columns holding 31 per cent of observed cells.

nodes.label: Six negative controls that plant real defects
nodes.rationale: A gate that cannot fail establishes nothing. Each control plants a defect and requires the corresponding gate to fail: a development scaler fitted on all cells; the Ebola scaler fitted on support and query; the target planted in an input channel; weekly incidence inflated past its cumulative reference; a training cell placed inside a test column; and a support cell dated after a query cell.

nodes.label: Disease-agnosticism reduces to one data-layer rule
nodes.rationale: Only the core transfer-safe channels reach the shared encoder. Three exclusions, each a correctness property: the Ebola deaths channel exists for one disease only, so presence or absence alone discloses identity; the static covariates place the diseases in disjoint geography, so a raw centroid identifies the disease outright; and mismatched self-loop conventions would give influenza twice the self-weight of dengue. The earlier reason for excluding covariates - asymmetric availability - was incomplete: all three diseases now carry populated covariates and the constraint still stands, because disjoint geography is intrinsic to what the covariates are. To be shared they would have to be made geography-free.

nodes.label: The three coded constraints carried into the modelling phase
nodes.rationale: Add the identity before any degree normalisation, or the four isolated influenza nodes divide by zero; keep static covariates out of the shared encoder, since geography identifies the disease; refit the scaler at every rolling origin, since the released scaler belongs to the headline split and has seen data beyond every origin. These are properties of the datasets that cannot be enforced from within them.

nodes.label: Rolling-origin backtest scaffold
nodes.rationale: Origins are fixed at build time although the backtest runs later, deliberately: deferred, the instruction to refit at each origin is exactly the step that becomes 'fit once and reuse', which leaks the test distribution into all five origins at once. Only cut points are stored - materialising dengue's masks would cost hundreds of megabytes to encode what one integer implies. Grouping mirrors the headline split, and Ebola has no rolling origins because expanding the training window beyond support is precisely the leakage the few-shot design forbids.

nodes.label: Determinism verified, not assumed
nodes.rationale: Node and date order are the schema's single source of truth and are fixed by the loaders; two consecutive builds produce identical arrays for all datasets.

nodes.label: COVID-19 bundle - NYT US states
nodes.rationale: Numbered §6 rather than inserted in disease order on purpose, because PROJECT.md and the progress record cite this note's section numbers and renumbering would silently break every reference. 49 nodes x 164 weeks, 100 per cent observed, reusing ColaGNN's state-adj.txt verbatim so it varies the disease and nothing else. Three costs travel with any number derived from it: Florida and DC are excluded (a 50th node would fork the adjacency and forfeit the identical-graph property), the adjacency is land contiguity built for influenza, and 2020-2023 is NPI-dominated so transfer may reflect policy response rather than pathogen dynamics. Until 2026-08-13 the loader hashed what it downloaded without comparing it to anything and the bundle was built outside build_datasets.py; folding it in took the suite from 86 to 101 gates and the rebuild was bit-identical.

nodes.label: Register of corrections to earlier releases of the audit note
nodes.rationale: Recorded so a figure quoted from an earlier draft can be identified as superseded: the clip justification, the 8,612/33,164 arithmetic, the 1,667 observed cells, the districts with no query week, the 30 zero-variance nodes, the single-phase invariant, the country-macro claim, the 'countries are not adjacent' premise, the new-cases sparsity claim, and the x220 case-definition multipliers.
